baseline.label: Balanced polar base
baseline.description: Default decision profile for a first sustained crewed presence with polar ISRU access and science return.

polar_isru.label: Polar ISRU priority
polar_isru.description: Power and volatile access dominate; communications can be solved with a relay.

crewed_sortie.label: Low-risk crewed sortie
crewed_sortie.description: Short-duration near-side mission: communications, trafficability, and abortability outweigh ISRU.

science_geology.label: Science / geology priority
science_geology.description: Maximise unique geology and sample context; infrastructure is secondary.

comms_first.label: Communications first
comms_first.description: Continuous direct-to-Earth communications are the hard constraint.
